recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the missing computable metadata requested by FHIR-26062, while respecting the already-applied spelling fix and later current-spec decisions for modifier type applicability.
issue_request: FHIR-26062 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It asked FHIR-I to change the search-modifier-code concept from ofType to of-type to match the normative search specification, and to add properties to the CodeSystem concepts indicating which search parameter types each modifier corresponds to.
initial_application: The spelling half was already applied: source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml currently uses of-type, and git history shows 7c3f73fb1f51cbbb40b332c19799a40dbab2bfaf changed ofType to of-type during later search modifier consistency work. The current CodeSystem did not have a property definition or per-concept values for modifier search parameter types before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has an active search-modifier-code value set entry, and the adjacent search-modifier-code CodeSystem source feeds the built terminology. The current search.html modifier table, refined by later decisions including FHIR-36684 and FHIR-37846, is the right source for the current modifier/type mapping; it leaves iterate untyped because iterate is not defined for any search parameter type by default and only applies to _include/_revinclude result parameters.
reconciliation: Added a CodeSystem property definition named search-param-type, constrained by the codesystem-property-valueset extension to ValueSet/search-param-type, and added repeated valueCode properties to the typed modifier concepts according to the current search table. No generated diagram or unrelated narrative files were changed.
source_changes: source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml: added the search-param-type CodeSystem property definition and per-concept search parameter type values for all generally typed modifiers; iterate remains without a type value because the current spec says it is not allowed anywhere by default.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue independently identified the same ofType/of-type inconsistency and its applied commit changed the current CodeSystem spelling.
Later Published issue produced the current search modifier/type summary table used as the basis for property values.
Later search work moved reference membership semantics from :in/:not-in to _in, so the current properties keep in and not-in mapped to token only.
